raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "dante-db" %}
{% set version = "0.1.1" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/dante_db-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 4da0c604ed391a51f00fb472ce38835f61fee8fbbc2585b6005c1488a87782a9

build:
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  number: 0

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - hatchling
    - pip
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - aiosqlite >=0.20.0
    - pydantic >=2.8.2

test:
  imports:
    - dante
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://github.com/senko/dante
  summary: A document store for Python backed by SQLite
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - thewchan
